Student Movement of 1974
The 1974 student movement, led by Jayaprakash Narayan (JP), was a major force in Indian politics, often referred to as the "Sampoorna Kranti"
It began in Gujarat in late 1973 as the Nav Nirman Andolan, triggered by a 30% hike in college mess fees and rising inflation. Students' peaceful protests escalated, leading to widespread civil unrest.
The movement's success in Gujarat led to the resignation of Chief Minister Chimanbhai Patel and the dissolution of the state assembly. This unprecedented victory inspired students in Bihar.
